svg.title: Finite — the market-memory mark
svg.desc: The easy ore came out first. A glass with the sand already down in the bottom bulb. Not a pick and not a shaft: what this model is about is the sand, not the digging - and not a trickle either, because a trickle drawn between two converging lines is invisible at the size this is engraved. Generated by tools/build-icons.mjs from data/pricing.json and data/components.json - do not edit. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.
